clause.quote: Therefore all CESR primitives MUST employ [[ref: mid-padding]] as defined.

description: A D key whose second character carries a 1 in the two bits that come from the zero lead byte, so the mid-padding is not zero. The raw value bits are untouched. The specification has no sentence saying such a stream must be rejected; the assertion rests on the cited MUST, which this stream violates, so it cannot be decoded as a conforming stream. Any rejection satisfies the assertion; the class in the note is informative.
title: Reject a primitive whose pad bits are not zero
